overall_summary: Most videos suffer from very low views, except for a massive outlier on a non-core topic (Maa Shayari at 130 views) and a few moderately performing self-respect status videos (41 views). Romance/breakup angst has low baseline performance right now, while everyday digital minimalism/self-respect and unexpected universal emotional triggers (like mothers) drive better initial curiosity.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'चैट डिलीट करने की हिम्मत' (41 views) and 'Self Respect Status Story' (41 views) perform better than abstract heartbreak.
winning_patterns.action: Focus hooks on concrete digital interface actions related to letting go or choosing oneself.

winning_patterns.evidence: ‘माँ जब पूछती है खाना खाया’ hit 130 views without a standard heartbreak hook.
winning_patterns.action: Reserve a small experiment budget to test universally relatable family/care emotions alongside core breakup content.

weak_patterns.pattern: Abstract or heavy emotional statements without a tangible object
weak_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing purely on general pain like 'Bewafai Ka Dard' (19 views) or generic overthinking without a specific trigger underperform relative to action-oriented titles.
weak_patterns.action: Ground every emotional script in a physical object or micro-habit (phone settings, notifications, shared items).
